verdicts.reason: Version A splits each pricing rule into a small, named, independently testable helper (member discount, coupon, shipping) and documents the region rate fields, whereas Version B folds everything into one long Quote function where unrelated rules are interleaved in a single loop.

Version B splits the monolithic Quote into small, named, documented helpers (countedItems, memberDiscount, applyCoupon, shippingCost) and a knownCoupons table, so each rule can be read, tested, and changed in isolation while remaining behaviorally identical to A.
